title: Special Weapons Rework — specials become weapons in slots, ammo counting dies
why: Specials are currently resources (specialAmmo counter, +50 Special powerups) and regular shots drain an ammo pool collected via powerups. This makes pickups feel like inventory management instead of gear. We make specials WEAPONS held in a generic slot array: both heroes share one pool (bomb / petal saw, random drop), rotation cycles default → slots skipping empties, and taking a damaging hit drops the selected special. No hardcoded slot count anywhere — SLOT_COUNT drives everything so 3+ slots later is a constant change.
outcomes: Hero carries specialSlots (array of length SLOT_COUNT) + selectedWeapon ('default' or slot index); pickup auto-selects and places by first-empty-then-replace-selected rule; same-special pickup replaces; damaging hits (damage() > 0 on hero) clear the selected slot with compact-left invariant (no gap before a filled slot); rotation skips empty slots; ammo/specialAmmo counters, their powerup defs, HUD counts, and reset logic are gone; both heroes can hold both specials; docs (powerup.yaml, hero.yaml, hero-mechanics.md, game-rules.md) describe the new system only. design.md is a frozen v1 snapshot in plans/ — never touched. Source of truth: petal-panic/docs/architecture/special-weapons.md.

milestones.name: Slot Model + Rotation + Firing
pattern: Generic slot array driven by SLOT_COUNT const
milestones.objective: The hero's weapon state is a slot array with pure helper methods; rotation and firing work off it; no behavior depends on there being exactly two slots.
milestones.success: Unit tests prove: placement order (first empty → replace selected → slot 0 when default selected), same-special replace, rotation cycle skipping empties, compact-left after loss, auto-select on pickup — all expressed against SLOT_COUNT, not literal indices beyond 0/1 where avoidable.

tasks.name: Slot model on Hero (SLOT_COUNT-driven)
tasks.what: In petal-panic/js/hero/hero.js add export const SPECIAL_SLOT_COUNT = 2 and give the hero: this.specialSlots = new Array(SPECIAL_SLOT_COUNT).fill(null) (entries null | 'bomb' | 'saw'), this.selectedWeapon starts as WEAPON_THORN (rename semantics: 'default'). Add pure helper methods: acquireSpecial(type) implementing placement rules (first empty slot → else if selectedWeapon is a slot index replace that slot → else replace slot 0; ALWAYS set selectedWeapon to the placed slot), loseSelectedSpecial() (clear selected slot if it is a slot index, then compact left: any filled slot after an empty one shifts into the earliest empty; selection falls back to lowest filled slot else WEAPON_THORN), and rotateWeapon() (cycle default → 0 → 1 → … → n-1 skipping empty slots; wrap around; stay put if nothing else exists). Keep WEAPON_THORN exported (consumers import it) but treat it as the default weapon token. Do NOT remove ammo fields yet (milestone 2).
tasks.why: One owner for slot semantics; every rule from special-weapons.md lives in three small testable methods instead of scattering across pickup/fire/hit code paths.
acceptance: acquireSpecial into empty hero places at slot 0 and selects it
second acquireSpecial places at next empty and selects it
third acquireSpecial while a slot is selected replaces THAT slot
third acquireSpecial while default is selected replaces slot 0
acquireSpecial of a type already held replaces it per placement rules and selects the new copy
loseSelectedSpecial on empty-slot selection is a no-op
loseSelectedSpecial on slot 1 with slot 0 empty moves the weapon to slot 0 and selects it
rotateWeapon cycles default→0→1→default skipping empty slots and wraps
all logic indexes via loops over SPECIAL_SLOT_COUNT — changing the const to 3 keeps every test passing

tasks.name: Wire rotation input + fireSpecial off slots
tasks.what: In petal-panic/js/systems/update.js replace the hero.toggleWeapon() call site with hero.rotateWeapon(). In petal-panic/js/combat/shooting.js rewrite fireSpecial(h, input): read the selected slot (h.selectedWeapon must be a numeric slot index holding a non-null type, else return — no more h.stats.special lookup, no more h.specialAmmo check/consume); spawn the special of the slot's type via specialPool.spawn as before; keep the 'special' labeled cooldown timer + trace records. Remove the old toggleWeapon() method from hero.js once update.js no longer calls it (check debugHarness.js line ~309 which reads selectedWeapon for display — keep working, it just reads the field). Update js/test/weaponToggle.test.js to assert the new rotation cycle (rename file to specialRotation.test.js).
tasks.why: Firing must consume the slot model end-to-end; leaving toggleWeapon behind creates two sources of weapon-selection truth.
acceptance: switch input rotates through occupied options only
firing with default selected spawns thorn as before
firing with a filled slot selected spawns that slot's special type and does NOT mutate the slot (no decrement)
firing with an empty/absent slot selected falls back safely (no throw, no spawn)
cooldown timer still gates rapid re-fire

milestones.name: Drops, Loss Wiring, Dead Code Sweep
pattern: Powerup def table is the single drop source
damage() > 0 on hero is the single loss hook
milestones.objective: Pickups grant shared random specials, damaging hits drop the selected special, and no ammo-counter code remains anywhere in js/.
milestones.success: Grep for specialAmmo and wallet ammo returns zero live references in js/ (test files updated); a bomb/saw powerup touch grants a random shared special; a damaging contact removes the selected special with the compact invariant; full test suite green.

tasks.name: Powerup drops: shared random special, kill ammo/special defs
tasks.what: In petal-panic/js/objects/powerup.js: delete the ammo def (+100 Ammo) and the special def (+50 Special); add ONE def specialDrop (label e.g. 'Special!', color kept) whose apply(hero) calls hero.acquireSpecial(Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'bomb' : 'saw') — identical for both heroes. Update POWERUP_TYPES accordingly. In petal-panic/js/world/levelConfigs.js update every powerups table entry: remove ammo keys, rename special keys to specialDrop keeping existing counts (lines ~305, 328-346, 400, 435, 470, 505 and the defaults block ~119). Check populate.js / any spawner that maps powerup type strings and update. Remove stats.special ('saw'/'bomb') from heroDefs.js since the hero no longer has an innate special type (grep for other readers first).
tasks.why: The def table + level configs are the only places drop identity is declared; making them agree with the shared-pool rule in one pass prevents half-migrated drops.
acceptance: POWERUP_TYPES contains no 'ammo' and no old 'special' key
collecting the special powerup calls acquireSpecial with 'bomb' or 'saw' (both heroes, no per-hero branch)
level config powerups tables validate against the new type list (populate tests pass)
no reader of stats.special remains

tasks.name: Special loss on damaging hit
tasks.what: Hook special loss where the hero actually pays damage. The central damage() in petal-panic/js/combat/damage.js drains target.energy for heroes; the cleanest single hook is at the hero-facing call sites in petal-panic/js/combat/collisionHandlers.js (contact handler ~line 217 and the ally/foe projectile path ~line 126) plus explosion.js hero routing (~line 179): whenever damage(source, heroEnt, ...) returns > 0 AND the hero is not dying, call heroEnt.loseSelectedSpecial(). Prefer adding the call inside a tiny helper (e.g. dealDamageToHero(source, hero, amt, method)) if the three sites share shape, so the rule stays in one place. i-frame/connect-protected paths already return dealt==0 or early-return, so they must NOT trigger loss — verify with a test.
tasks.why: special-weapons.md defines loss as 'a hit that costs damage'; damage() > 0 is exactly that predicate and every damaging hero hit already funnels through these call sites.
acceptance: enemy contact dealing damage clears the selected special slot
projectile hit dealing damage clears it too
explosion hit dealing damage clears it too
hit absorbed by intangible/i-frames does NOT clear it
connectProtected hit does NOT clear it
after loss the compact-left invariant holds (slot0 empty + slot1 filled is impossible)

tasks.name: Dead ammo code sweep + HUD + reset
tasks.what: Remove the ammo quantity system end-to-end: (1) hero.js — delete wallet.ammo / wallet.specialAmmo from the baseline snapshot (~lines 104-112), the legacy get/set bridges for ammo + specialAmmo (~290-294), and the §21 comment block describing the old toggle; (2) systems/gameRules.js — delete the ammo reset lines (~113-124) and the TUNING_INVENTORY.ammo reference (~49); on death-reset clear specialSlots + selectedWeapon instead (fresh attempt starts empty, per mechanic doc); (3) systems/hud.js — replace the two ammo count lines (~106-113) with a slot display: default marker + up to SPECIAL_SLOT_COUNT slot icons showing held special or dimmed empty; (4) grep -rn 'specialAmmo\|\.ammo\b' petal-panic/js/ and fix every remaining live reference (debugHarness.js snapshot ~309 should report specialSlots instead); (5) update tests referencing counters: hud83.test.js, tuning.test.js, reward.test.js, levelFlow.test.js, contextualAim.test.js as needed.
tasks.why: Half-removed counters are the classic source of phantom bugs (death checks, persistence, debug views); one sweep with a grep gate makes 'gone' verifiable.
acceptance: grep -rn 'specialAmmo' petal-panic/js/ returns zero matches
grep -rn '\.ammo' petal-panic/js/ returns zero live matches (comments explaining history allowed)
HUD renders slots, not counts
death/reset leaves specialSlots empty and selectedWeapon at default
full suite: node petal-panic/js/test/run-all.mjs green
